text:
Yuki (Marketing): Heads-up: APAC launch next week needs a Japan-localized press release and legal/compliance check due to data residency note. Publisher asked for embargo at 09:00 JST. Can we meet that?
Hana (PR): Who asked? Any exclusives?
Yuki (Marketing): Local business daily 'NipponTech'. They requested embargoed copy at 09:00 JST for morning edition. No contract.
Tomo (Legal-JP): We need to vet the data residency line and the KMS mention. Send Japanese copy to legal for review; allow 3 business hours min.
Mika (Localization): I can translate the release but need final English copy by 02:00 JST to hit 09:00 JST preview. ETA for translation ~2.5 hrs.
Rae (Social): For JP socials, best window is 11:00 JST. If we preview at 09:00, social stays at 11:00. Need creatives by 09:30 JST.
publish-bot: scheduled_post.create  post_id=apac-launch-jp; publish_time=11:00 JST at 1951234600
Hana (PR): Proposal: Offer NipponTech an embargoed preview at 09:00 JST but keep live publish at 11:00 JST to coordinate socials and partner newsletters. If they insist on early publish escalate to execs.
Tomo (Legal-JP): Add embargo sentence in JP: "プレビューはエンバーゴの下で提供されます。11:00 JST以前の出版は書面による同意なしに禁じられます。"
Yuki (Marketing): Action items: English final by 02:00 JST (Yuki), Mika translate by 04:30 JST, Legal review complete by 07:00 JST, assets to ops by 08:30 JST. Hana send preview offer to NipponTech now.
Hana (PR): Sending now. I'll paste the reply when sent.
Hana (PR): Sent. Copy pasted: ---
NipponTech 編集部様 09:00 JST に向けてエンバーゴ付きプレビューを提供できます。公開は11:00 JSTの予定です。09:00 JSTより前の公開は書面による同意なしに禁じられます。アセットは08:30 JST頃共有予定です。
---
Mika (Localization): Translation queued. Will upload JP PDF when done.
Tomo (Legal-JP): On review watch. If legal needs more time, we'll withdraw preview access and keep live publish schedule.
Yuki (Marketing): Thanks team. Keep thread updated if NipponTech pushes for hard exclusive.
Rae (Social): Standing by for creatives.
